Open تعني افتح، وClose أغلق، وRaise ارفع: Open means افتح, Close أغلق, Raise ارفع, Clap صفّق. After the verb we name the part, like your eyes or your hands. Please makes the request polite.
dad تعني الأب وmom الأم. grandpa الجد وg: dad means الأب and mom الأم. grandpa الجد and grandma الجدة. brother الأخ and sister الأخت. We use my before the word when we talk about our family.
How old are you? تعني كم عمرك؟ نجيب بـ I: How old are you? means كم عمرك؟ We answer with I am, then the number of years, then years old. Original example: I am eight years old.
square مربع، triangle مثلث، rectangle مس: square مربع, triangle مثلث, rectangle مستطيل, circle دائرة, diamond معيّن, star نجمة. Look at the shape of each card before choosing the word.
نقول How are you? للسؤال عن الحال. نرد ب: We say How are you? to ask how someone is. We reply with I am fine or I am great. When meeting someone we say Nice to meet you, and the reply is Nice to meet you, too.
نستخدم I am ثم صفة: I am hungry تعني أنا: We use I am then an adjective: I am hungry means أنا جائع, and I am thirsty means أنا عطشان. The contraction I'm equals I am.
cap تبدأ بـ c، أما clap فتبدأ بـ cl. نقو: cap starts with c, while clap starts with cl. We say the two letters together in clap and clock, and we review the meaning difference between cap and clap.
نستخدم I am wearing للملابس التي نرتديها: We use I am wearing for the clothes we have on now, like I am wearing a jacket. We say a hat for one item, but we do not put a before jeans or shoes because they are plural.
Whose hat is this? تعني لمن هذه القبعة؟: Whose hat is this? means لمن هذه القبعة؟ The word mine means ملكي, and It is not mine means إنها ليست ملكي.
I like your hat مجاملة معناها تعجبني قبع: I like your hat is a compliment meaning أعجبتني قبعتك. The reply is Thank you, then You are welcome. Review p in parrot and panda and b in bear and banana.
نسأل What are you doing? ونرد بـ I am ثم: We ask What are you doing? and reply with I am then a verb ending in ing, like I am watching TV. The talk here is about something happening now.
مع I نستخدم am، ومع you نستخدم are. لذلك: With I we use am, and with you we use are. So we say I am playing and You are playing, not I are playing.
Can I speak to Ali? للسؤال عن شخص في اله: Can I speak to Ali? asks for someone on the phone. In phone and photo, ph is pronounced /f/. Also review tr in tree and truck and dr in dress and drink.
نستخدم is مع المفرد ثم الصفة: The snake: We use is with the singular then an adjective: The snake is long. The adjective comes after is, and we do not add s to it when describing a plural.
long عكس short، وbig عكس small، وbeautif: long is the opposite of short, big is the opposite of small, and beautiful is the opposite of ugly. quiet means هادئ and its opposite is noisy, and strong is the opposite of weak.
نراجع gr في grass وcr في crab وgl في gla: We review gr in grass, cr in crab, gl in glass and cl in class. In snake and snow we hear sn together. Read the whole word after saying its beginning.
نستخدم He is أو She is للمفرد، وThey are: We use He is or She is for the singular, and They are or We are for the plural. A verb ending in ing comes after them, like They are cycling.
نضيف not بعد is أو are للنفي: She is not: We add not after is or are for the negative: She is not playing. For a question we put the auxiliary first: Are they jumping? The reply is Yes, they are or No, they are not.
sweet للحلو، وsour للحامض، وsalty للمالح: sweet is for الحلو, sour for الحامض, salty for المالح and tasty for اللذيذ. We say The lemon is sour, and with a plural The chips are salty.
She has orange juice تعني لديها عصير برت: She has orange juice means لديها عصير برتقال. In the negative we use does not have, like She does not have apples. After does we use have, not has.
للسؤال عن العمر نستخدم How old are you?: To ask about age we use How old are you? and about where someone lives Where do you live? You can reply I live in Jeddah. Do not mix the age question with the where-you-live question.
نضع my وyour وhis وher وour وtheir قبل ا: We put my, your, his, her, our and their before the noun, like My name is Ali. With names we use are: Their names are Ali and Omar.
mine وyours وhers وours وtheirs تقف وحده: mine, yours, hers, ours and theirs stand alone and do not need a noun after them: This bag is mine. But my needs a noun: my bag. We ask Whose bag is this? about the owner.
في meet وsheep نسمع صوت ee الطويل، وفي m: In meet and sheep we hear the long ee sound, and in meat and read it is written ea. In rain and train we hear ai, and in play and day we hear ay.
نسأل What is that? للمفرد ونرد It is a w: We ask What is that? for the singular and reply It is a whale. We ask What are those? for the plural and reply They are seals. We use is with the singular and are with the plural.
I think تعني أظن، وI do not think تعني ل: I think means أظن, and I do not think means لا أظن, like I think sharks are scary. We choose is or are depending on whether the animal is singular or plural.
للمقارنة بين اثنين نستخدم faster than أو: To compare two things we use faster than or bigger than. For the superlative we use the fastest or the biggest. We double g in bigger, and change y to i in scarier and scariest.
oa في goat وboat غالبًا صوت طويل، ومثله: oa in goat and boat is usually a long sound, and so is ow in snow and yellow. But ow in cow and brown is a different sound. Read the whole example; do not judge from the letters alone.
نسأل What sport do you like? ونرد I like: We ask What sport do you like? and reply I like football. With he and she we add s to the verb in the affirmative: He likes tennis.
سؤال بـ do أو does: A question with do or does
نستخدم Do مع I وyou وwe وthey، وDoes مع: We use Do with I, you, we and they, and Does with he and she. After does the verb goes back to its base form: Does she like basketball? not Does she likes.
نستخدم want to ثم الفعل دون تغيير: I wan: We use want to then the verb without change: I want to try pottery. With he it becomes He wants to try pottery. We do not drop to.
نستخدم more قبل الصفات الطويلة مثل excit: We use more before long adjectives like exciting and dangerous: more exciting than. For the superlative we say the most exciting, and we do not add er to exciting.
We use the present simple for repeated actions, like I feed the fish. The word sometimes means أحيانًا and helps describe how often something happens.
نضيف s مع he وshe: She sets the table. ب: We add s with he and she: She sets the table. After sh, ch and s we usually add es: He washes the dishes. And go with he becomes goes.
نقول Does she vacuum the floor? دون s بع: We say Does she vacuum the floor? without s after does. In the negative: She does not vacuum, and with I we say I do not vacuum.
نراجع ar في car وfarm، وor في fork، وer: We review ar in car and farm, or in fork, and er in teacher and sister. Notice that teacher ends in er, but that does not mean every word with er is a job name.
usually تصف العادة، فنستخدم المضارع: I u: usually describes a habit, so we use the present: I usually get up at six. yesterday points to the past: I got up at seven yesterday.
بعض الأفعال لا نضيف لها ed: get يصبح got: Some verbs do not take ed: get becomes got, eat becomes ate, come becomes came, do becomes did, go becomes went and take becomes took.
بعد did نستخدم الفعل الأصلي: What time d: After did we use the base verb: What time did you get up? not did you got up. In the answer we go back to the past: I got up at seven.
نضع at قبل الساعة. راجع ng في ring وspri: We put at before the time. Review ng in ring and spring, nk in think and drink, and ck in rock and clock. These are groups at the end of words, not the beginning.
What does your dad do? سؤال عن وظيفة الأ: What does your dad do? asks about the father's job, not what he is doing now. We reply He is a pilot. We use a before a singular job name like a teacher.
نسأل Where does she work? ونرد She works: We ask Where does she work? and reply She works in a hospital. With they we use do and work: Where do they work?
نستخدم I want to be ثم الوظيفة: I want t: We use I want to be then the job: I want to be a scientist. We use be after to in this pattern.
في knee وknife وknock لا ننطق k. وفي lig: In knee, knife and knock we do not say the k. In light, night and right we do not say the gh. The verb ending s has different sounds in walks, reads and teaches.
aunt means عمة أو خالة, and uncle means عم أو خال. cousin can be a boy or a girl. We describe a person with kind or helpful, and we put the adjective after is: My aunt is helpful.
How often? تعني كم مرة أو ما مدى تكرار ا: How often? means كم مرة أو ما مدى تكرار الفعل؟ We use always for what is permanent, usually for the usual, sometimes for the occasional, rarely for the rare and never for what does not happen.
عادةً يأتي ظرف التكرار قبل الفعل الأساسي: The frequency adverb usually comes before the main verb: I always walk. With the verb be it comes after: He is always kind. We do not add another negative to never.
Whose تسأل عن المالك. نقول This bag is m: Whose asks about the owner. We say This bag is mine or It is hers. The pronouns mine, yours, his, hers, ours and theirs stand without a noun after them, while my and her come before the noun.
نستخدم المضارع البسيط للعادة: I make my: We use the present simple for a habit: I make my bed every day. With now we use am, is or are then an ing verb: She is sweeping the floor now.
في المضارع البسيط نضيف s أو es: He gets: In the present simple we add s or es: He gets dressed. In the present continuous we do not add s to the verb; we say He is getting dressed.
Can you wash the dishes? طلب مهذب من شخص: Can you wash the dishes? is a polite request to another person. After can comes the base verb without to and without s.
Can I help you? عرض للمساعدة. يمكن الرد: Can I help you? offers help. You can reply Yes, please or No, thank you. Attention: clear the table means رفع الأطباق, while set the table means تجهيز المائدة.
I make my bed every day.
للأحداث المنتهية نستخدم الماضي. مع كثير: For finished events we use the past. With many verbs we add ed: climb becomes climbed and wait becomes waited. yesterday can point to the past.
نستخدم did not أو didn’t ثم الفعل الأصلي: We use did not or didn't then the base verb: She did not cry, not did not cried. The negative does not change with the subject.
نقدم Did ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل الأصلي: Did: We put Did first, then the subject, then the base verb: Did you water the flowers? The reply is Yes, I did or No, I did not. We do not add ed after did.
ليس كل ماضٍ ينتهي بـ ed. go تصبح went، و: Not every past ends in ed. go becomes went, take becomes took, make becomes made, see becomes saw and write becomes wrote. Memorize the verb with a short example.
السؤال والنفي يظلان كما هما: The question and the negative stay as they are
حتى مع الفعل غير المنتظم نستخدم أصله بعد: Even with an irregular verb we use its base form after did: Did you go shopping? and I did not go shopping. We do not say did you went.
نستخدم quickly لوصف السرعة، وslowly للبط: We use quickly to describe speed, slowly for slowness and carefully for care. The adverb describes how the action happened, like He walked slowly.
and للإضافة، وbut للتضاد، وbecause لذكر: and adds, but contrasts, because gives the reason, so gives the result and when links an event to its time. In I was tired, so I rested the result comes after so.
نتحدث عن الاهتمامات بأفعال مثل enjoy وli: We talk about interests with verbs like enjoy and like. After enjoy the verb usually takes ing: I enjoy painting. friendly is an adjective meaning ودود, and unfriendly means غير ودود.
usually وevery day يدلان على عادة فنستخد: usually and every day point to a habit, so we use the present simple. yesterday and last week point to a finished time, so we use the past, like I visit the fair every year and I visited it yesterday.
أفعال مثل know وwant وlike وbelieve تصف: Verbs like know, want, like and believe describe a state, and we usually use them in the simple, not the continuous. We say I know the answer, not I am knowing the answer.
أفعال الحركة مثل make وplay يمكن أن تأتي: Action verbs like make and play can be continuous: She is making a model now. We use am, is or are then an ing verb, and we tell the difference between She is excited and She is exciting.
architect هو المهندس المعماري، وlayout م: architect is المهندس المعماري, and layout is مخطط توزيع المكان. We use There is for the singular and There are for the plural, or The house has a basement to describe what the house contains.
نستخدم will ثم الفعل الأصلي للتوقع أو قر: We use will then the base verb for a prediction, an instant decision or offering help: I will look for the key. The negative is will not, shortened to won't. For a question we put Will first: Will you help me?
نستخدم am أو is أو are ثم going to ثم ال: We use am, is or are then going to then the base verb for an intention or a prior plan: She is going to visit us tonight. With I we use am, and with they we use are.
غالبًا نستعمل going to لخطة معدة من قبل: We usually use going to for a plan made before, or with present evidence, and will for a decision at the moment of speaking or a prediction. The meaning can overlap, so we read the context and do not choose based on the word tomorrow alone.
نستخدم be going to للنية: I am going to: We use be going to for an intention: I am going to be an engineer. We use a before a job like a mechanic, and an if it starts with a vowel sound like an engineer.
may وmight يعبران عن احتمال، وليس يقينًا: may and might express possibility, not certainty: She may become a pilot. The base verb follows them without to. We put not after them for the negative: He might not work in an office.
نضيف سؤالًا قصيرًا لتأكيد الفكرة. إذا كا: We add a short question to confirm the idea. If the sentence is affirmative, the tag is negative: This is a gallery, isn't it? If it is negative, the tag is affirmative: She isn't a pilot, is she?
نستعمل الفعل المساعد نفسه: You can help,: We use the same auxiliary: You can help, can't you? With the present simple we use do or does: She works here, doesn't she? And we choose the pronoun that matches the subject.
نستخدم should ثم الفعل الأصلي للنصيحة: Y: We use should then the base verb for advice: You should measure the flour. To advise against something we use should not or shouldn't. We do not add to after should.
had better يتبعها الفعل الأصلي، وهي نصيح: had better is followed by the base verb; it is stronger advice tied to a situation and a possible consequence. The negative is had better not: You had better not leave the oven on. We do not use to after it.
نستخدم if ثم المضارع البسيط، وفي النتيجة: We use if then the present simple, and the present simple in the result too, for a rule or a repeated result: If you heat butter, it melts. This is not a prediction about one future event.
نستخدم First ثم Next أو Then وأخيرًا Fin: We use First, then Next or Then, and finally Finally. Instructions start with the base verb like Mix, Pour and Stir. Do not forget the difference between flour الدقيق and flower الزهرة.
نستخدمه عندما نهتم بالشيء الذي يقع عليه: We use it when we care about the thing the action happens to. The pattern: am, is or are then the third form. Insects are eaten by birds means تؤكل الحشرات بواسطة الطيور.
نختار فعل be حسب الشيء الذي نتحدث عنه: T: We choose the verb be according to the thing we talk about: The nest is built for the singular, and The nests are built for the plural. eaten and built are the third forms of eat and build.
يمكن إضافة by ثم الفاعل الحقيقي، ويمكن ح: We can add by then the real doer, and we can drop it if it is unimportant or unknown. The nest is built in a tree is a correct sentence without saying who built it.
نستخدم where لربط مكان بما يحدث فيه: A n: We use where to link a place to what happens in it: A nest is where birds lay eggs, and The desert is where camels live. where here means المكان الذي and is not a question.
The desert is the place where camels live.
العش هو المكان الذي تضع فيه الطيور البيض: The nest is the place where birds lay eggs.
نستخدم if ثم المضارع البسيط، ومعه المضار: We use if then the present simple, with the present simple for a repeated or general result: If we rest well, we feel better. The idea here is a habit or a general truth.
نستخدم if ثم المضارع البسيط، وفي النتيجة: We use if then the present simple, and in the result will then the base verb for a future possibility: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home. We do not put will in the if part in this pattern.
نستخدم a few بمعنى بضع مع الاسم المعدود: We use a few meaning بضع with a plural countable noun: a few strawberries and a few eggs. Each berry or egg can be counted on its own.
نستخدم a little مع غير المعدود مثل milk: We use a little with uncountable nouns like milk, salt and bread: a little milk. To count bread we use a unit like a slice of bread. The examples here are for learning the language, not medical instructions.
It is made of have or has then the third form. We use have with I, you, we and they, and has with he, she and it, like I have played and She has taken.
for بعدها مدة مثل for two years، وsince: for is followed by a duration like for two years, and since by a starting point like since March or since 2024. Example: She has taken lessons since March.
How long have you played the drums? يسأل: How long have you played the drums? asks about a duration continuing until now. We put have or has before the subject then the third form, not the past verb after did.
الماضي البسيط يأتي مع وقت ماضٍ محدد ومنت: The past simple comes with a specific finished past time like yesterday: I visited the festival yesterday. For a fresh link to the present you can use I have just finished. just also appears with the past simple depending on context and usage; we do not count the other form wrong just because just is there.
نستخدم was أو were ثم فعل ing لحدث كان م: We use was or were then an ing verb for an event that was in progress at a past time. With I, he, she and it we use was, and with you, we and they we use were.
يمكن أن يقطع الماضي البسيط حدثًا مستمرًا: The past simple can interrupt an ongoing event: They were traveling when we called. The traveling was in progress, and the call happened during it. We use the context; we do not memorize when alone as a mechanical rule.
نستخدم who مع الأشخاص: The firefighter w: We use who with people: The firefighter who helped us was kind. The part starting with who tells which firefighter we mean.
نستخدم which للأشياء، ويمكن استخدام that: We use which for things, and that can be used with people or things in defining clauses, like The rocket that we saw was large. We do not use who for the rocket.
راجع الكلمات حسب مجموعتها: Review the words by their group
فيه كلمات لمعروضات المتحف زي painting وs: It has words for museum exhibits like painting, skeleton and fossil, and animals like rabbit, parrot and turtle. The words modern حديث and enormous ضخم جدًا describe the thing; they are not the name of an exhibit or an animal. Ask yourself whether the word names a thing or describes it.
What للسؤال عن إيه، وWho عن مين، وWhere: What asks about إيه, Who about مين, Where about فين أو منين and When about إمتى. How old is a complete question about age. You must read the answer to choose the question: In May answers a time, Hadi answers a person and Thirteen answers an age.
راجع I am وhe/she/it is وyou/we/they are: Review I am, he/she/it is and you/we/they are. For the near singular this and the far singular that, and for the near plural these and the far plural those. In the questions here the distance and number are written. We use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound at the start of a singular countable noun: a museum and an airplane.
الأمر يبدأ بالفعل: Open your books وClos: The imperative starts with the verb: Open your books and Close the door. Make your bed means رتب سريرك, Brush your teeth means فرّش أسنانك and Use the broom to sweep means استخدم المقشة للكنس. Get off the phone in this context means بطل استخدام التليفون. For the negative put Do not or Don't before the verb: Don't touch.
قبل ما تجاوب عن أي إعلان، دور على اليوم: Before you answer about any ad, look for the day, month, place, the person in charge and the instructions. The text here is an original ad about an imaginary trip, not a real offer or an invitation to book. All the information needed to solve is in the full text above each question, and no personal data is asked from you.
راجع I have وShe has، والسؤال Do you hav: Review I have and She has, and the question Do you have any cousins? For the regular plural we usually add s, but the plural of child is children and of shelf is shelves. Read the subject and the number of people before you choose.
There is قبل المفرد وThere are قبل الجمع: There is before the singular and There are before the plural. The negative: There isn't and There aren't. under means تحت and across from means مقابل على الناحية التانية. Every place relation in the questions here is written, and no question needs a house picture or a map that is not there.
live in قبل المدينة وlive on قبل الشارع: live in before the city and live on before the street or the floor. Turn right means لف يمين and Turn left means لف شمال. In comparisons we say bigger than, and in the superlative the biggest. good becomes better then the best. This is a review of Units 5-8 skills, not a map or a recommendation for a real place.
المضارع المستمر am/is/are وبعدها فعل مع: The present continuous is am/is/are then a verb with ing: I am writing and They are playing. For a question put the auxiliary first, and for the negative use not. would like is followed by a noun, like a sandwich, but if a verb follows we use to: would like to read.
اقرأ الرسالة كلها وحدد العيلة والسكن وال: Read the whole letter and identify the family, home, places, hobbies and current activities. The text here is an original imaginary letter, not from a real person's mail, and no correspondence address or sending is required. All the needed information is written above each question, and there is no audio question or missing picture.
الحديقة مقابل عمارتنا على الناحية التاني: The park is across from our building, on the other side.
المنهج السعودي · أول متوسط · الجزء الأول: المنهج السعودي · Intermediate 1 · الجزء الأول · Unit 1
بنقول Good morning في الصبح، وGood after: We say Good morning in the morning, Good afternoon in the afternoon and Good evening in the evening when meeting. Good night is used when saying goodbye at night or before sleep, not instead of a greeting when arriving.
مع I نستخدم am. مع he وshe والاسم المفرد: With I we use am. With he, she and a singular name we use is. With you, we, they and the plural we use are. The contractions: I am = I'm, he is = he's, she is = she's, you are = you're, we are = we're, they are = they're.
في سؤال be بنقدم الفعل: You are new. تصب: In a be question we put the verb first: You are new. becomes Are you new? When meeting someone we say Nice to meet you, and the reply is Nice to meet you, too. The sentence This is my friend is how you introduce your friend.
بنقرأ books، ونكتب بقلم أو قلم رصاص، ونق: We read books, write with a pen or a pencil, cut with scissors, erase with an eraser, color with crayons and draw with paints. The sentence starts with a capital letter, and the question ends with a question mark.
احفظ ترتيب أيام الأسبوع والشهور. يوم غير: Memorize the order of the days of the week and the months. A day is not a date: What day is today? is answered with the day name, and What is the date? is answered with the month and day number. Day and month names start with a capital letter: Monday and January. In the book's examples the month comes before the day number, so 4/13 here means April thirteenth.
one وtwo وthree أعداد بنعد بيها. first و: one, two and three are counting numbers. first, second and third are ordinal numbers, and we use them for ordering months and reading dates. Watch the spelling of fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth and twentieth. 21st is read twenty-first, 40 is written forty without u, and 80 is written eighty.
What day للسؤال عن يوم الأسبوع، وWhat mo: What day asks about the day of the week, What month about the month, and What is the date? about the date. When asks about time, and the answer can be a month, a day or a full date. How old asks about age: How old is Hadi? He is fourteen. The age question also works for the age of a building or a thing.
نستخدم in مع الشهور والفصول والسنين: in: We use in with months, seasons and years: in November, in winter, in 2026. We use on with days and dates: on Thursday, on November twenty-first. We do not put on before the month name alone.
our معناها الخاص بنا، وyour الخاص بك أو: our means الخاص بنا, your الخاص بك أو بكم and their الخاص بهم. They all come before a noun: Our names are Rami and Hadi. When you address your classmates you say your books, and when you talk about other people's bags you say their bags.
الأمر يبدأ بالفعل: Open your books يعني: The imperative starts with the verb: Open your books means افتحوا كتبكم, and Close your books اقفلوها. Work with a partner means اشتغل مع زميل. Take out your pencils means طلّعوا أقلامكم. Put your bags away means حطّوا الشنط في مكانها. Please makes the request polite, and Listen and repeat means اسمع وكرر. Our questions here are reading and need no recording.

Do not use a or an before a plural: fossils, not a fossils.

Turn left لف شمال، وTurn right لف يمين،: Turn left means لف شمال, Turn right means لف يمين and Go straight means امشِ على طول. للمقارنة نستخدم غالبًا than. الصفات القص: For comparisons we usually use than. Short adjectives take er: tall becomes taller and old becomes older. If the adjective ends in e we only add r: nice becomes nicer. A y after a consonant changes to i: busy becomes busier. In big and hot we double the last letter: bigger and hotter. Tell apart taller than and the tallest in the street.
استخدم It بدل اسم مفرد لغير العاقل، زي ا: Use It instead of a singular non-human noun, like the neighborhood or the museum. Use They instead of a plural, like the houses or the neighbors. Use We if the group includes the speaker: My neighbors and I is referred back to with We. Read the noun the pronoun refers to before you choose.

The full text is above each reading question, and no recording is required.

The word now or right now helps you know the action is happening at the present time.

Example: She is reading. For the negative add not: I am not reading, He is not reading and They are not reading. The contractions: I'm, He's, They're, isn't and aren't.

The answers are Yes, I am or No, I am not, and Yes, she is or No, she isn't. To ask about the activity use What with the auxiliary: What is he doing? What are they doing? Do not add do or does with this form.
غالبًا نزود ing مباشرة: eat تصبح eating: Usually we add ing directly: eat becomes eating, play becomes playing and study becomes studying. In write and ride we drop the final e: writing and riding. In run, sit and chat we double the final consonant before ing: running, sitting and chatting. This is the spelling of the verbs we will need in the unit.
للطلب أو التعبير عن رغبة استخدم would li: For a request or to express a wish use would like then a noun: I would like a sandwich. If a verb follows, use to before it: I would like to read. The contraction I'd means I would here. For questions: Would you like a salad? What would you like to do? Where would you like to go? When would you like to eat?

For asking about a job: ⁦What does he do?⁩
can ومعناها القدرة ممكن نستبدلها بـ know: ⁦can⁩, meaning ability, can be replaced with ⁦know how to.⁩ With ⁦she⁩ we say ⁦She knows how to type.⁩ The negative: ⁦She does not know how to type.⁩ The present continuous ⁦am⁩, ⁦is⁩ or ⁦are⁩ then ⁦ing⁩ describes the action happening now. أدوات السؤال ومعنى الإجابة: Question words and the meaning of the answer
How عن الحال، و What عن إيه، و When عن إ: ⁦How⁩ asks about how someone is, ⁦What⁩ about إيه, ⁦When⁩ about إمتى, ⁦Where⁩ about فين أو منين, ⁦Who⁩ about مين and ⁦Why⁩ about the reason. ⁦How long⁩ asks about duration. ⁦Fine, thanks⁩ answers how someone is, ⁦In February⁩ answers a time and ⁦Because I am on vacation⁩ answers a reason. النفي والسؤال والإجابة القصيرة: The negative, the question and the short answer
في النفي حط not بعد am أو is أو are: She: In the negative put ⁦not⁩ after ⁦am⁩, ⁦is⁩ or ⁦are: She is not filming.⁩ In a yes-or-no question put the verb ⁦be⁩ first: Are they working?⁩ The answers are ⁦Yes, they are⁩ or ⁦No, they are not.⁩ With ⁦he: Yes, he is⁩ or ⁦No, he is not.⁩ And the question about what is happening now is ⁦What are you doing now?⁩

البسيط بيصف حاجة عامة أو عادة. مع I و yo: The simple describes something general or a habit. With ⁦I⁩, ⁦you⁩, ⁦we⁩ and ⁦they⁩ use the base verb: ⁦They work.⁩ With ⁦he⁩, ⁦she⁩ and ⁦it⁩ add ⁦s: She works.⁩ Verbs ending in ⁦s⁩, ⁦x⁩, ⁦ch⁩ or ⁦sh⁩ take ⁦es: fixes⁩, ⁦teaches⁩ and ⁦washes.⁩
السؤال والنفي بـdo وdoes: The question and the negative with do and does
مع I و you و we و they نستخدم do في السؤ: With ⁦I⁩, ⁦you⁩, ⁦we⁩ and ⁦they⁩ we use ⁦do⁩ in questions and ⁦do not⁩ in the negative. With ⁦he⁩, ⁦she⁩ and ⁦it⁩ we use ⁦does⁩ and ⁦does not.⁩ After ⁦does⁩ or ⁦does not⁩ the verb returns to its base form: ⁦Where does she work?⁩ and ⁦He does not work in a bank.⁩ Do not add ⁦s⁩ to the verb after ⁦does.⁩
لو بتتكلم عن هدف استخدم want to وبعدها ا: If you are talking about a goal use ⁦want to⁩ then the base verb. Example: ⁦I want to be a translator.⁩ With ⁦she: She wants to be a pilot.⁩ And in the question ⁦What does he want to be?⁩ Notice ⁦want⁩ has no ⁦s⁩ after ⁦does.⁩
أسماء مهن كتير بتنتهي بـ er زي teacher و: Many job names end in ⁦er⁩ like ⁦teacher⁩, ⁦driver⁩ and ⁦photographer.⁩ Some end in ⁦ist⁩ like ⁦scientist⁩, ⁦dentist⁩ and ⁦journalist⁩, and some in ⁦or⁩ like ⁦actor⁩, ⁦director⁩ and ⁦translator.⁩ Memorize the job name with its meaning and the verb it does, and do not guess the ending without checking the word.
جملة الوصل بتضيف معلومة عن الاسم. مع الأ: A relative clause adds information about the noun. With people ⁦who⁩ or ⁦that⁩ works, and with things and animals ⁦that⁩ or ⁦which⁩, according to the rule in the book. In the choice questions here we do not put ⁦who⁩ and ⁦that⁩ together as two competing answers about the same person, because both work. Example: ⁦A nurse is someone who helps sick people.⁩
and بتربط كلمات أو أفكار متشابهة. but بت: ⁦and⁩ links similar words or ideas. ⁦but⁩ shows a contrast: ⁦The job is useful, but it is stressful. because⁩ gives the reason: ⁦I like the job because I help people.⁩ Read what the connector in the question is meant to do before you choose.

سؤال How often وعدد المرات: The How often question and the number of times
How often بنسأل بيها كل قد إيه أو عدد مر: ⁦How often⁩ asks how frequently or how many times an activity repeats. ⁦once a week⁩ مرة في الأسبوع, ⁦twice a week⁩ مرتين, ⁦three times a week⁩ ثلاث مرات and ⁦every day⁩ كل يوم. Read the days or the number written in the question, and do not rely on a schedule that is not shown.
always دائمًا، و usually عادةً، و often: ⁦always⁩ دائمًا, ⁦usually⁩ عادةً, ⁦often⁩ كتير, ⁦sometimes⁩ أحيانًا, ⁦seldom⁩ نادرًا and ⁦never⁩ أبدًا. Their usual place is after ⁦be: He is always on time.⁩ And with other verbs before the verb: ⁦She usually paints. sometimes⁩ can also come at the start of the sentence; it is not fixed to one place.
know how to وبعدها فعل أساسي معناها يعرف: ⁦know how to⁩ then a base verb means knowing how to do something, like ⁦can.⁩ Example: ⁦I know how to swim.⁩ And with ⁦he: He knows how to swim.⁩ The negative ⁦I do not know how to cook⁩ means I cannot cook, like ⁦I cannot cook⁩ in the meaning of ability here.
ممكن صيغة ing تكون اسم أو فاعل: Painting: The ⁦ing⁩ form can be a noun or a subject: ⁦Painting is a relaxing hobby.⁩ And we use it after ⁦enjoy⁩, ⁦dislike⁩, ⁦suggest⁩, ⁦recommend⁩, ⁦feel like⁩ and ⁦cannot stand⁩, and after ⁦spend time.⁩ Example: ⁦I enjoy drawing⁩ and ⁦I spend my free time reading.⁩
بعد want و hope و would like و would lov: After ⁦want⁩, ⁦hope⁩, ⁦would like⁩ and ⁦would love⁩ use ⁦to⁩ then the base verb. Example: ⁦She hopes to join the club⁩ and ⁦I would love to come along. like⁩, ⁦love⁩, ⁦hate⁩ and ⁦prefer⁩ can be followed by a ⁦gerund⁩ or an infinitive. That is why we do not put ⁦playing⁩ and ⁦to play⁩ as two competing options after ⁦like⁩ in a single-answer question.

المعدود له مفرد وجمع، زي an egg و two eg: A countable noun has a singular and a plural, like ⁦an egg⁩ and ⁦two eggs⁩, ⁦a carrot⁩ and ⁦three carrots.⁩ In the intended use here ⁦rice⁩ and ⁦water⁩ are uncountable, so we say ⁦some rice⁩, not ⁦a rice.⁩ The book notes that some nouns accept both ways depending on the meaning: ⁦a salad⁩ or ⁦some salad⁩, and ⁦a soup⁩ or ⁦some soup.⁩ That is why we do not fix one category for them in every situation.
في أمثلة الإثبات البسيطة نستخدم some: Th: In the simple affirmative examples we use ⁦some: There is some juice⁩ and ⁦There are some eggs.⁩ In the negative and in questions about whether something exists we use ⁦any: There is not any rice⁩ and ⁦Are there any carrots?⁩ A polite offer can take ⁦some: Would you like some water?⁩ A question does not automatically mean ⁦some⁩ is wrong.
مع غير المعدود نقدر نعد العبوة أو القطعة: With uncountable nouns we can count the container or the piece: ⁦a bottle of juice⁩, ⁦a cup of coffee⁩, ⁦a glass of water⁩ and ⁦a piece of cake.⁩ The noun that decides ⁦is⁩ or ⁦are⁩ is the head of the group: ⁦There is a glass of water⁩, and ⁦There are two glasses of water.⁩
too قبل الصفة: too hot. too much قبل غير: ⁦too⁩ comes before the adjective: ⁦too hot. too much⁩ before an uncountable noun: ⁦too much salt. too many⁩ before a countable plural: ⁦too many carrots. enough⁩ comes after the adjective: ⁦cool enough⁩, and before the noun: ⁦enough eggs⁩ or ⁦enough time.⁩ It can be followed by ⁦to⁩ with a verb: ⁦too hot to eat⁩ and ⁦enough eggs to make an omelet.⁩

مع I و he و she و it نستخدم was. مع you: With ⁦I⁩, ⁦he⁩, ⁦she⁩ and ⁦it⁩ we use ⁦was.⁩ With ⁦you⁩, ⁦we⁩ and ⁦they⁩ we use ⁦were.⁩ The negative is ⁦was not⁩ or ⁦were not.⁩ For a question we swap the verb before the subject: ⁦Was it interesting?⁩ and ⁦Were they at home?⁩ The short answer: ⁦Yes, it was⁩ or ⁦No, they were not.⁩
في الإثبات المنتظم غالبًا بنضيف ed زي vi: In the regular affirmative we usually add ⁦ed⁩ like ⁦visited⁩, ⁦watched⁩ and ⁦played.⁩ The irregular verb has its own form: ⁦go⁩ becomes ⁦went⁩, ⁦buy⁩ ⁦bought⁩, ⁦see⁩ ⁦saw⁩, ⁦take⁩ ⁦took⁩, ⁦eat⁩ ⁦ate⁩ and ⁦write⁩ ⁦wrote.⁩ The time here is clear with words like ⁦yesterday⁩ and ⁦last weekend.⁩
نستخدم did في سؤال الفعل العادي: What di: We use ⁦did⁩ in a question with an ordinary verb: ⁦What did you do?⁩ and ⁦Did you visit the museum?⁩ In the negative ⁦did not visit⁩, not ⁦did not visited.⁩ After ⁦did⁩ or ⁦did not⁩ the base verb returns to its form. But a ⁦be⁩ question uses ⁦was⁩ and ⁦were⁩, not ⁦did.⁩
What was it like? و How was it? بيسألوا: ⁦What was it like?⁩ and ⁦How was it?⁩ ask for a description or an impression: ⁦It was amazing.⁩ The question ⁦Where were you?⁩ is about a place. ⁦That is too bad⁩ is an expression of sympathy, ⁦You did?⁩ can express surprise, and ⁦out of this world⁩ means wonderful, not a real place in space.
very و really و quite و pretty و extreme: ⁦very⁩, ⁦really⁩, ⁦quite⁩, ⁦pretty⁩ and ⁦extremely⁩ come before the adjective in the book's examples: ⁦really interesting⁩ and ⁦extremely excited.⁩ With ⁦quite⁩ and a singular noun notice the place of the article: ⁦quite an interesting exhibit⁩, but ⁦a very interesting exhibit.⁩ Some book examples have more than one correct ⁦intensifier⁩, and we do not present two correct ones as if only one works.
في شرح الكتاب enormous و huge معناهم ver: In the book's explanation ⁦enormous⁩ and ⁦huge⁩ mean ⁦very big⁩, ⁦tiny⁩ means ⁦very small⁩, ⁦brilliant⁩ means ⁦very clever⁩, ⁦awful⁩ means ⁦very bad⁩ and ⁦delicious⁩ means ⁦very tasty.⁩ The book chooses an intensifier like ⁦absolutely delicious⁩ with the strong adjective instead of ⁦very delicious.⁩ The meaning questions here tell different adjectives apart; they do not force you to choose between ⁦absolutely⁩ and ⁦totally⁩ when both can be right.

If the time part comes first in the sentence, use a comma after it, like ⁦After the tour, we went home.⁩ The exclamation mark shows a strong feeling, and quotation marks are for words quoted exactly.

مع اسم مفرد نستخدم there was ، ومع جمع ن: With a singular noun we use ⁦there was⁩, and with a plural ⁦there were.⁩ The negative is ⁦there was not⁩ and ⁦there were not.⁩ The question: ⁦Was there an accident?⁩ or ⁦Were there two cars?⁩ This describes something that existed at a past time.
Why بتسأل ليه، و because بتقدم السبب: Wh: ⁦Why⁩ asks ليه, and ⁦because⁩ gives the reason: ⁦Why are you worried? Because I have a test.⁩ The word ⁦ago⁩ comes after the duration: ⁦two days ago⁩ and ⁦ten minutes ago.⁩ Not before it, and it does not mean a coming duration.
someone شخص ما، و no one ولا شخص. nothin: ⁦someone⁩ شخص ما, and ⁦no one⁩ ولا شخص. ⁦nothing⁩ ولا حاجة, and ⁦anything⁩ is used in questions or negatives like ⁦Did you hear anything?⁩ and ⁦I did not hear anything.⁩ In standard English in these examples we do not combine ⁦did not⁩ with ⁦nothing⁩ to make the same negative. With ⁦someone⁩ and ⁦no one⁩ we use a singular verb like ⁦someone was⁩ and ⁦no one was.⁩
I stayed at home because I was ill: الجز: ⁦I stayed at home because I was ill:⁩ the part after ⁦because⁩ is the reason. ⁦I was tired, so I went home:⁩ the part after ⁦so⁩ is the result. In the questions we make clear whether a reason or a result is needed, instead of a sentence that allows two connectors with two different meanings.
لو الجملة مثبتة، نوافق بـ so والفعل المس: If the sentence is affirmative, we agree with ⁦so⁩ and the auxiliary then the subject: ⁦I am tired⁩ answered with ⁦So am I. I play tennis⁩ answered with ⁦So do I. I went home⁩ answered with ⁦So did I.⁩ If it is negative we use ⁦neither: I am not tired⁩ answered with ⁦Neither am I⁩, and ⁦I did not go⁩ answered with ⁦Neither did I.⁩ The auxiliary must match the tense and pattern of the original sentence.
It will only take a minute تعبير إن الكل: ⁦It will only take a minute⁩ is an expression that the talk will not take long. ⁦What is up?⁩ means إيه اللي حاصل؟ ⁦Do not lose your cool⁩ means ما تتعصبش. ⁦The thing is⁩ introduces the problem or the point you need to say. ⁦relieved⁩ is the feeling of relief after worry goes away, and ⁦worried⁩ قلقان.

نستخدم should للنصيحة وبعدها الفعل من غي: We use ⁦should⁩ for advice, then the verb without ⁦to⁩ and without ⁦s: You should study more.⁩ The negative is ⁦should not⁩ or ⁦shouldn't: You should not shout.⁩ The question ⁦What should I do?⁩ Here the questions make clear whether the needed advice is affirmative or negative.

فاعل قبل الفعل: I و you و he و she و it: Subject before the verb: ⁦I⁩, ⁦you⁩, ⁦he⁩, ⁦she⁩, ⁦it⁩, ⁦we⁩ and ⁦they.⁩ Object after the verb or a preposition: ⁦me⁩, ⁦you⁩, ⁦him⁩, ⁦her⁩, ⁦it⁩, ⁦us⁩ and ⁦them.⁩ Example ⁦She helped me⁩ and ⁦I spoke to him.⁩ The pronoun refers to a clear noun in the question.
قبل الاسم نستخدم my و your و his و her و: Before a noun we use ⁦my⁩, ⁦your⁩, ⁦his⁩, ⁦her⁩, ⁦its⁩, ⁦our⁩ and ⁦their: my book⁩ and ⁦their bags.⁩ If the noun is understood and we replace it, we use ⁦mine⁩, ⁦yours⁩, ⁦his⁩, ⁦hers⁩, ⁦ours⁩ and ⁦theirs: This book is mine.⁩ We do not put a noun after ⁦mine⁩ in this pattern. ⁦its⁩ for possession has no apostrophe, and ⁦it's⁩ is a contraction of ⁦it is⁩ or ⁦it has⁩ depending on the sentence.
I just did معناها عملت ده من شوية، والفع: ⁦I just did⁩ means I did it a short while ago, and the intended verb must be clear from what was said before. ⁦and things like that⁩ completes examples with the meaning وحاجات زي كده. ⁦Nothing much⁩ means not much. ⁦What is the matter?⁩ and ⁦What is wrong?⁩ ask about the problem.
